PRENATAL CYTOGENETICS LABORATORY
[redacted location] Regional Genetics Centre

QF-PCR RAPID ANEUPLOIDY SCREENING REPORT

PATIENT DETAILS
Name: [redacted name]
DOB: [redacted date]
Hospital Number: [redacted ID]
Specimen Number: [redacted ID]

CLINICAL DETAILS
Reason for referral: Advanced maternal age (43 years)
Gestation: 16 weeks by ultrasound dating
Sample type: Amniotic fluid
Date received: [redacted date]
Date reported: [redacted date]

TEST PERFORMED
Quantitative Fluorescence Polymerase Chain Reaction (QF-PCR) for rapid aneuploidy detection

METHODOLOGY
QF-PCR analysis was performed on uncultured amniocytes using chromosome-specific short tandem repeat (STR) markers. Multiple informative markers were analysed for each chromosome:
- Chromosome 13: D13S631, D13S258, D13S742, D13S628
- Chromosome 18: D18S535, D18S391, D18S858, D18S386
- Chromosome 21: D21S1435, D21S1411, D21S1412, D21S1437

DNA was extracted directly from amniotic fluid cells without culture. PCR amplification was performed using fluorescently labelled primers, and products were analysed by capillary electrophoresis on an ABI 3500 Genetic Analyzer.

RESULTS

Chromosome 13: NORMAL
All informative markers show expected biallelic patterns
Peak area ratios within normal range (1:1 to 1:1.5)

Chromosome 18: NORMAL
All informative markers show expected biallelic patterns
Peak area ratios within normal range (1:1 to 1:1.5)

Chromosome 21: NORMAL
All informative markers show expected biallelic patterns
Peak area ratios within normal range (1:1 to 1:1.5)

MATERNAL CELL CONTAMINATION
No evidence of maternal cell contamination detected

INTERPRETATION
No abnormality detected. Results are consistent with a normal complement for chromosomes 13, 18, and 21. This excludes trisomy 13 (Patau syndrome), trisomy 18 (Edwards syndrome), and trisomy 21 (Down syndrome) in the fetal sample.

LIMITATIONS
This test only screens for numerical abnormalities of chromosomes 13, 18, and 21. It does not detect:
- Structural chromosomal abnormalities
- Mosaicism below 20%
- Abnormalities of other chromosomes
- Single gene disorders

RECOMMENDATIONS
Full karyotype analysis of G-banded chromosomes from cultured amniocytes to follow. This will provide comprehensive cytogenetic analysis of all chromosomes and detect structural abnormalities not identified by QF-PCR.

Reported by: [redacted name], Clinical Scientist
Authorised by: [redacted name], Consultant Clinical Geneticist
